name: harold-skills
description: Harold's personal collection of Claude Code skills, organized as plugins.

plugins.name: clinical-research
plugins.description: Clinical research workflow skills: study design, variable coding, statistical analysis, and paper drafting. For clinical medicine researchers conducting retrospective cohort studies.

plugins.name: excalidrawer
plugins.description: Code-first Excalidraw diagram generation. Four skills (flowchart / timeline / architecture / sequence) clarify intent via AskUserQuestion, shape data into JSON, and call the excalidrawer npm CLI to produce .excalidraw / .svg / .png outputs.

plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Personal memory wiki built from your conversations. Pluggable connectors (lark / 飞书 today; wechat / slack later) pull raw chats + meeting transcripts, render them losslessly to markdown, then distill them into an obsidian-style wiki of people and things — persons / groups / topics (events live inline and in a dated log digest), written with #tag + Dataview fields + [[wikilinks]] + provenance anchors. Verb-oriented skills: ingest (fetch+render), recap (distill), comm-memory (dictation CRUD), reply-coach (draft high-friction replies). User data lives under ~/.memex/ — plugin dir is read-only references and prompts.

plugins.name: content-creator
plugins.description: Content creation toolkit for short-video / social-feed creators (Xiaohongshu, 视频号, YouTube). Currently ships thumbnail-gen — interactive HTML/CSS thumbnail generator with portrait-photo layout math, multi-platform spec presets (3:4 / 4:3 / 9:16 / 16:9), multi-ratio derivation, and Playwright screenshot rendering. Bundled Smiley Sans (得意黑) font. Roadmap: title-writer / post-writer / tag-gen / video-script.
